name: Local Recommendations
overview: Privacy-first personalized recommendations based on local watch history
description: Generate per-user content recommendations using TF-IDF embeddings and cosine similarity. All processing happens locally with zero tracking or cloud dependencies. Recommendations appear as virtual libraries accessible from all Jellyfin clients.

versions.changelog:
Fix movie playback in virtual libraries
- Replace per-movie file symlinks with directory symlinks to the source movie folder
- File symlinks were resolved by Jellyfin's scanner to the source file path, causing virtual items to be deduplicated with source library items and played back via the source item path, breaking playback from the virtual library
- Directory symlinks keep the virtual path intact; the OS resolves them at stream time, matching the approach already used for TV series since v0.8.5
- Removes artwork/trailer symlinking code (source folder content is accessible directly via the directory symlink)

Simplify Leaving Soon age semantics for TV series
- For series, timeSinceAdded now uses DateLastMediaAdded (most recent episode addition) instead of folder ctime
- A show that had a new season added recently is correctly treated as new, even if the series folder is old
- Removed episode-level enumeration fallback in GetLastWatchDate: Jellyfin propagates LastPlayedDate to Series when any episode is watched, so series-level UserData is sufficient

Fix TV show virtual libraries: use series folder symlinks instead of per-episode symlinks
- Fix: shows appeared as single orphaned episode cards (Jellyfin matched per-episode symlinks back to source library items)
- Series folders are now a single directory symlink to the source series folder
- Jellyfin discovers all episodes naturally; no more filename collisions or path-length limits
- Applies to both Leaving Soon Shows and per-user TV recommendation libraries

Fix Leaving Soon: recently-added items, orphaned episode entries, and CI reliability
- Fix: items recently added to library (within minAgeDays) are now removed from Leaving Soon state
- Fix: stale state IDs that resolve to Episode/Season items are skipped in sync
- Fix: test for Cleanup semantics updated to match interaction-based age logic

Fix Leaving Soon: recently-added items and orphaned episode entries
- Fix: items recently added to library (within minAgeDays) are now removed from Leaving Soon state, matching Discover eligibility logic
- Fix: stale state IDs that resolve to Episode/Season items are skipped in sync instead of creating orphaned episode cards in the library

Leaving Soon: interaction-based age semantics
- Age is now min(time since added to library, time since last watched by any user)
- Items recently rewatched are excluded, regardless of how old the content is
- For TV series, last-watched is the most recent episode watch date across all users
- Favorites and in-progress items remain always protected

Fix Leaving Soon bugs and CI test reliability
- Fix: reducing Leaving Soon count now takes effect immediately (count was not enforced on reduction)
- Fix: TV series now appear in Leaving Soon libraries (DateCreated is folder ctime on Linux; PremiereDate used as age reference for series)
- Fix: non-deterministic test embeddings caused intermittent CI failures

Add Leaving Soon and Removal Candidates virtual libraries
- Items least likely to be watched by any user are flagged as Leaving Soon
- After a configurable dwell period, flagged items move to Removal Candidates
- Collection sibling protection: if any member of a franchise is saved, all siblings are protected
- Pre-computed embeddings shared between recommendations and Leaving Soon scoring
- Configurable: enable/disable, item count (movies + TV), minimum age, dwell period
- Fix: meta.MediaType compilation error in LeavingSoonService and VirtualLibraryManager

Fix BoxSet collection lookup using LinkedChildren
- Correctly reads BoxSet member items via LinkedChildren (fixes v0.7.1 where collections always showed 0)
- Items belonging to the same BoxSet (franchise) now score higher similarity
- Collection membership extracted from Jellyfin BoxSets at analysis time
- IDF weighting suppresses ubiquitous collections, boosts niche ones

Add collection/BoxSet dimension to TF-IDF embeddings
- Items belonging to the same BoxSet (franchise) now score higher similarity
- Collection membership extracted from Jellyfin BoxSets at analysis time
- IDF weighting suppresses ubiquitous collections, boosts niche ones
- Fixes v0.7.0 which shipped with incorrect version number

Migrate from .strm files to filesystem symlinks (#13)
- Fixes transcoded playback on Jellyfin 10.11.7+ (GHSA-j2hf-x4q5-47j3)
- Symlinks preserve source extensions; media pipeline treats them as regular files
- Artwork symlinked from source folder (propagates custom posters automatically)
- Trailer discovery delegated to Jellyfin's native scanner
- Removed ImageSyncService and EnableImageSync/SyncBackdrops settings
- WINDOWS: requires Administrator or Developer Mode enabled for symlink creation

Filter recommendations by user library access (#10)
- Items from libraries a user cannot access are excluded from recommendations
- Applies to both personalized and cold-start recommendation paths
- Respects per-user library permissions including disabled libraries

Fix playback freeze when playing from recommendation libraries (#8)
- Never remove virtual library items from event handlers (deferred to next refresh)
- Ignore PlaybackStart/PlaybackProgress events to prevent DB write storms during playback
- Only sync play status on meaningful events (PlaybackFinished, TogglePlayed, etc.)
- Known tradeoff: partially watched items may appear in Continue Watching twice until next refresh

Bug fixes for series recommendations and playback crashes
- Fixed: Partially watched series not included in watch history, causing all users to get identical cold-start recommendations (#7)
- Fixed: Playback from recommendation libraries crashing with database failures (#8)
- Series watch history now detected at episode level instead of requiring all episodes watched
- Virtual library items no longer removed during active playback

Image sync for custom posters and backdrops
- Custom poster images are now preserved in recommendation libraries
- Copies poster.jpg and backdrop.jpg from source items to virtual folders
- Configurable: Enable/disable image sync and backdrop copying
- Fixes issue where user customizations (e.g., French posters) were lost

Decade-based temporal similarity and bug fix
- Recommendations now consider content from similar time periods
- Decade grouping (1980s, 1990s, etc.) replaces continuous year normalization
- Improves temporal relevance alongside genre/actor/director similarity
- Tested with production data: ~12 decades extracted from 970 items
- Observable impact: 24% of movie recommendations changed, 8% of TV
- Fixed: In-progress TV series no longer appear in recommendations

Series filtering fix and play status sync
- Fixed fully watched series appearing in recommendations
- Play status sync from source library when virtual items are scanned
- Rating proximity scoring feature
- Removed NFO file generation (Jellyfin doesn't read NFO for .strm files)
- Reduced debug logging noise

Fix NFO metadata parsing
- Fixed XML encoding (UTF-16 to UTF-8) so Jellyfin reads runtime correctly
- Added cast, directors, and writers to NFO files
- Added fileinfo/streamdetails for video/audio/subtitle stream selectors

NFO metadata and trailer support
- NFO files with full metadata (runtime, ratings, genres, studios, tags)
- Local trailer support via -trailer.strm files
- Movie folder structure for better metadata handling
- Fixed copy buttons on setup page
- Improved documentation

Initial beta release
- Per-user personalized recommendations for movies and TV shows
- Content-based filtering using TF-IDF embeddings
- Virtual library integration for universal client compatibility
- Configurable weighting (favorites, rewatches, recency)
- Abandoned series exclusion
- Daily scheduled updates with manual refresh option
- Complete privacy - all processing local
